title: Under-relaxed active-set coupling and direct active-set solve
purpose: Compare two bounded repairs of the qualified DUMMY-06 failure mechanism against the exact DUMMY-05 oracle: under-relaxation of the same active-set Picard map and a non-iterative direct active-set solve.

algorithm: solve coupled FULL trial with U=R
if FULL trial h1>=hmin, accept FULL
otherwise solve coupled ZERO trial with U=0
if ZERO trial h1<=hmin and h1>=datum, accept ZERO
otherwise activate h1=hmin and solve U from balance plus exchange
if ZERO trial h1<datum, fail closed

experiments.S1: within non-switching FULL and ZERO regimes, observed relaxed error ratio equals q=1-omega(1+lambda)
experiments.S2: within interior CURTAILED, observed relaxed error ratio equals 1-omega relative to the curtailed fixed exchange
experiments.S3: preregistered stiff case with omega_star=0.4 transitions CURTAILED -> FULL and reaches exact oracle exchange -6 m3 on the second relaxed update
experiments.S4: same stiff case at omega=0.8 reproduces the preregistered -36/24 two-cycle, confirming strict rather than inclusive fixed-regime stability bound
experiments.S5: omega=0.5 converges to the exact stiff-case oracle after regime identification without changing management or physical equations
experiments.S6: direct active-set solve matches DUMMY-05 FULL, CURTAILED and ZERO oracle solutions across a dense parameter/request grid while never calling oracle.solve() internally
experiments.S7: direct active-set physical infeasibility agrees with DUMMY-05 fail-closed classification
experiments.S8: omega_star=1/(1+lambda) removes fixed-regime linear error in one relaxed update for multiple lambda values once initialized inside the correct active set

interpretation_rules: under-relaxation changes only the coupling iteration, not the physical or management equations
the bound 0<omega<2/(1+lambda) is local to fixed FULL/ZERO regimes of this surrogate
omega_star is not claimed globally optimal across active-set switches
direct active-set solve is a research oracle-like algorithm, not a Ribasim allocation implementation
no empirical convergence tolerance is used for the analytic ratio tests
forbidden: no production coupling or solver change
no claim of global convergence for arbitrary nonlinear models
no claim that direct active-set solve is appropriate for real Ribasim networks
no change to DUMMY-05 exact physics or management priority
